native_source.publication_binding: The native contribution is immutable. Any later canonical publication is separately bound to these unchanged Git blobs by the integration receipt.

course.title: Markov chains: where probability goes next

findings: Both quickstarts correctly identify the actual course title and 14-question/5-concept preview, including the final word next.
The route distinguishes downloading the course from exporting a computed observation; the latter is not presented as learner input.
The included learner initially retains its bundled lesson. Instructions require choosing the course, inspecting attribution and preview, then explicitly Start this deck.
All static local href/src routes in the entry page, learner and explorer resolve to included regular files; product bytes match the stated immutable native contribution.
Manifest clearly separates four unchanged product files from two packaging additions, and keeps later canonical publication attribution separate.
Instructions describe local memory, explicit downloads and optional network references without promising persistence or measured learning benefit.
limits: Read-only wording, route and exact-source packaging review; no repeated browser or lesson suite.
The delivery owner separately owns actual file-URL/extraction/download/chooser receiving.
Superseded root-level r1 package is outside this acceptance.
